name: clauseway/vault
title: Security (dark, scroll-driven lock)
description: A pinned dark section: heading and three points on the left, a document that folds into a sealed card and a lock that closes as the visitor scrolls. Needs full width and no parent with hidden overflow.

sub.default: Built so that only the right people see each document, and you can see who did.

bullets.default:
key | Access is set by role, per contract.
eye | Every view and edit is written to a log.
trash | You choose what is kept and what is deleted.
